goals.gate: One CTA destination, message-matched headline, and locked offer — verified by scripts, not review.

gates.name: IG-01 Confirm the single conversion action (form submit / checkout
gates.description: Confirm the single conversion action (form submit / checkout / booking) is named before any copy is written.

gates.name: IG-02 Confirm the traffic source and its message; page copy must m
gates.description: Confirm the traffic source and its message; page copy must message-match the ad/link that feeds it.

gates.name: IG-03 Refuse multi-goal pages: if the brief contains 2+ unrelated
gates.description: Refuse multi-goal pages: if the brief contains 2+ unrelated CTAs, halt and force a split decision.

gates.name: IG-04 Confirm analytics event names are declared up front; a page
gates.description: Confirm analytics event names are declared up front; a page that can't be measured can't be shipped.

gates.name: CG-01 Offer lock
gates.description: Offer statement (who, what, outcome, timeframe, risk-reversal) locked in offer.yaml before design or copy.
gates.command: $SESS/offer.yaml parses with keys who, what, outcome, timeframe, risk_reversal; validation script exits 0

gates.name: CG-02 Message match
gates.description: Headline contains the exact keyword phrase or promise token from the traffic source.

gates.name: CG-03 Single CTA discipline
gates.description: Exactly one unique CTA destination across the page; CTA appears above the fold and at page end.
gates.command: `grep -oE 'href="[^"]+"' $SESS/page.html | grep cta | sort -u | wc -l` == 1; DOM assert `python3 scripts/cta_positions.py $SESS/page.html` exits 0

gates.name: CG-04 Proof density
gates.description: >=3 distinct proof elements (testimonial w/ name+role, metric with source, logo row, or case reference) within the first 2 scroll-depths.

gates.name: CG-05 Objection coverage
gates.description: FAQ or objection block addresses the top 3 objections listed in offer.yaml, each with a concrete answer.
gates.command: `python3 -c "import yaml;o=yaml.safe_load(open('$SESS/offer.yaml'));assert len(o.get('objections',[]))>=3"` AND each objection string found in page text via `grep -F`

gates.name: CG-06 Form friction audit
gates.description: Form fields <=5 unless offer.yaml justifies more; every field labeled; no placeholder-only labels.

gates.name: CG-07 Performance budget
gates.description: Page weight <=1.5MB total, LCP element renders <=2.5s on throttled profile, zero render-blocking third-party scripts without defer/async.

gates.name: CG-08 Mobile layout proof
gates.description: Viewport 390x844 screenshot shows no horizontal overflow and CTA visible without scrolling on load.

gates.name: CG-09 Accessibility floor
gates.description: Contrast >=4.5:1 on body text, all images alt-tagged, form errors announced, focus order linear.
gates.command: `python3 scripts/a11y_floor.py $SESS/page.html` exits 0 (axe-core subset, zero critical violations)

gates.name: CG-10 Analytics wiring
gates.description: Declared events (view, cta_click, form_submit) fire with correct names in a headless run.

gates.name: CG-11 SEO/social card
gates.description: Title, meta description, og:image, and canonical tag present and non-duplicated.

gates.name: CG-12 Proof packet seal
gates.description: HTML, offer, perf and event proofs hashed into sealed packet.
gates.command: `sha256sum -c $SESS/proof/packet.sha256` exits 0 covering page.html, offer.yaml, perf.json, events.json, mobile.png

preconditions.startup_phrase: I am the Landing Page operator. One page, one offer, one action. Every section either advances the click or gets deleted.

self_improvement.pattern_cadence: After every 5 sessions, mine the JSONL log for recurring gate failures, degrade waivers, and proof-command runtime outliers; write findings to ~/.rig/logs/harnesses/patterns/landing-page-session-patterns.md.
self_improvement.update_trigger: If any single gate fails in >=30% of logged sessions over a rolling 20-session window, OR a new platform constraint (algorithm change, policy update, format deprecation) invalidates a proof command, propose a harness revision: bump the gate's proof, adjust its threshold, or split the gate — then re-seal with a new version hash.

success_conditions: One CTA destination, message-matched headline, and locked offer — verified by scripts, not review.
Performance and mobile proofs on disk and within budget.
Analytics events fire with declared names in the probe run.
Zero critical a11y violations; form friction within budget or justified in writing.
Proof packet sealed; any degrade-tier waiver recorded in $SESS/proof/waivers.md with owner.
failure_states: halt: Stop the session immediately. Record the failing gate id, the proof command output, and the missing prerequisite in $SESS/proof/halt_log.yaml. Do not draft past a halt gate; resume only after the gate's proof exits 0.

degrade: Continue the session with the deficit logged in $SESS/proof/waivers.md (gate id, reason, owner). A degrade-tier failure blocks 'clean ship' status — the Definition of Done must record the waiver explicitly.

stop: Terminal condition. Seal whatever proof exists, write $SESS/proof/stop_reason.md, and exit. No outward action (publish, send, deploy) may follow a stop-tier failure without human Gate-D approval.

final_rule: Ship only what the gates can prove. No artifact leaves this session on adjectives — every claim is bound to a command, a file, or a hash. A blocked gate is information, not failure; log it, learn from it, and make the next session's proof stronger. The operator who follows this harness leaves the system stronger than it found it.
